keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «안개가 텅 빈 눈의 그림자로 변했다(문제)» 와 «친구들이 고양이를 가두었던 그 책을 펼쳤다(해결)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (the fog became a shadow with empty eyes) and the solution (the friends opened the heavy book that had trapped the cat). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: The four friends, the gray cat, a shadow and the headmistress
A shadow made of fog came into the castle and called every student's name.
The friends understood it was lonely and found its lost name.

qs.q: Why did the friends believe the shadow this time?
qs.qko: 이번에는 친구들이 그림자의 말을 믿은 이유는 무엇인가요?
opts: Because Mira's whisperleaf began to glow
Because the headmistress told them to
evs: The gray cat ran straight to it, and to everyone's surprise, Mira's whisperleaf began to glow.
Thick fog crept under the doors, and a voice whispered every student's name in the dark.
Just then, the headmistress ran into the hall, and tears filled her eyes.
Then the fog took the shape of a tall, thin shadow with empty eyes.
why: 1권에서 배운 것처럼 속삭임잎은 진실을 들을 때만 빛나요. 그림자가 말할 때 «미라의 속삭임잎이 빛나기 시작했다» 고 했으니, 이번에는 진실이었어요.
As we learned in Book 1, whisperleaf glows only for the truth. «Mira's whisperleaf began to glow», so this time the shadow was telling the truth.

qs.q: In «the shadow was not evil at all,» what does «evil» mean?
qs.qko: «the shadow was not evil at all» 에서 «evil» 은 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: very bad and wanting to hurt others
evs: "I was a student here long ago," the shadow said. "I called you in the fog because I was lost and lonely."
A week later, the thirteenth bell rang again, and this time the whole castle shook.
When they read it out loud, the shadow became a smiling boy made of silver light.
So the friends opened the heavy book from under the stairs, the one that had trapped the cat.
why: 그림자는 해치려던 것이 아니라 «길을 잃고 외로워서» 아이들을 불렀어요. 그러니 «not evil» 은 «남을 해치려는 나쁜 존재가 아니다» 라는 뜻이에요.
The shadow called them because it was «lost and lonely», not to hurt them. So «evil» means very bad and wanting to hurt others.

qs.q: Who was Elric, and why had the headmistress waited so long?
qs.qko: 엘릭은 누구였고, 교장 선생님은 왜 그렇게 오래 기다렸나요?
opts: He was her little brother, a student lost a hundred years ago
He was a new teacher who came late
He was the owner of the green train
evs: "I was a student here long ago," the shadow said. "I called you in the fog because I was lost and lonely."
"Elric," she whispered, "my little brother, I have been waiting for you for a hundred years."
Theo understood at last: scary things sometimes only need someone brave enough to understand them.
A week later, the thirteenth bell rang again, and this time the whole castle shook.
why: 그림자는 «오래전 이곳의 학생» 이었고, 교장 선생님은 그를 «내 남동생» 이라 부르며 «100년 동안 기다렸다» 고 했어요. 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
The shadow «was a student here long ago», and the headmistress called him «my little brother» and «waited for a hundred years». You need both sentences.

ends: What will Elric do now that he is free?
자유를 되찾은 엘릭은 이제 무엇을 할까?
What new adventure will the four friends have next?
네 친구에게 다음에는 어떤 모험이 기다리고 있을까?

write.src: “It is important to <u>listen to others</u> because <u>everyone has a story</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «중요한 일 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what is important and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because friends help each other)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because friends help each other)
